crossRefs.note: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.

translations.web: He said to them, “Depart for three days, then come back to me.” So the people departed.
translations.bsb: Rehoboam answered, “Go away for three days and then return to me.” So the people departed.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
